description: Trigger accuracy for analysis-coach. The three boundaries that actually collide: elicit versus strategy-coach:feature (arguing about what to build versus specifying an agreed build), insight versus atlas-coach:market (our data versus their company), and story versus insight (summarizing an analysis versus producing one).

what should we ask the billing team before we build this

analyse this orders export and tell me what it says
what should we chart from this data
